threat_event: Ransomware group enters through the teleradiology vendor's shared VPN account, encrypts servers, workstations, and cloud workloads, and forces EHR downtime and ambulance diversion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared vendor VPN account without MFA; flat network; EDR alerts watched only in business hours; backups reachable from the directory
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07; SYS-10; all clinical processes (P05 BP-01 to BP-05)
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B); 164.312(d)); C-HPH-R07 (42 CFR 485.625(a)(1)); C-HPH-R08 (CPG: Multifactor Authentication)
existing_controls: EDR on servers and workstations; firewall; monthly patching
treatment_plan: Replace the shared vendor account with named accounts and MFA through the identity provider; 24x7 managed detection and response; segment medical devices, OT, and servers; immutable backups (R-003)

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email to a staff mailbox spreads across the flat network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No phishing exercises; contracted clinicians untrained; flat network; business-hours-only alert monitoring
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(5)(ii)(B)); C-HPH-R08 (CPG: Email Security; Basic Cybersecurity Training); C-HPH-R09 (HICP CSP 1)
existing_controls: MFA on email; email filtering from the productivity suite; EDR
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises; training for contracted clinicians and agency staff; 24x7 alert response (same contract as R-001)

threat_event: Backups are deleted or encrypted along with production, so servers, the interface engine, and the imaging archive cannot be recovered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup appliance joined to the hospital directory; cloud vault in the production account and region; no immutable retention; imaging archive never restore-tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 backup vault; local backup appliance
existing_controls: Nightly backups; daily cloud snapshots
treatment_plan: Remove the appliance from the directory; separate backup account with immutable retention and a second region; quarterly restore tests including the imaging archive

threat_event: EHR vendor outage or loss of the connection to the hosted EHR exceeds the 2-hour RTO, and untested downtime procedures lead to medication or result errors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Downtime procedures from 2019; downtime PCs never tested; no downtime drills
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-06 downtime PCs; P05 BP-01 BP-02 BP-03
existing_controls: Vendor disaster recovery (SOC 2); downtime PCs print census and MAR reports every 2 hours
treatment_plan: Rewrite downtime procedures; test downtime PCs monthly; quarterly unit downtime drills; record the vendor RTO and RPO in the contract

threat_event: Patient data is copied out before encryption and posted on a leak site (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress monitoring; no central logs; file server holds exported reports
existing_controls: Firewall blocks inbound traffic
treatment_plan: Central log collection with egress alerting; remove patient exports from the file server; data loss rules in the productivity suite

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported operating system on the CT acquisition workstation to disrupt imaging or move into the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS; on the flat network; no device inventory or MDS2
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(1)(ii)(B)); C-HPH-R04 (FD&C 524B, manufacturer duties; procurement lever); C-HPH-R09 (HICP CSP 9)
existing_controls: Behind the hospital firewall
treatment_plan: Isolate on a device network now; request the manufacturer's supported upgrade path and MDS2; plan replacement

threat_event: Tampering with the infusion pump drug-library server changes dose limits, and a patient receives a harmful infusion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drug-library server unpatched and on the flat network; no change alerting
existing_controls: Pharmacist reviews library changes before each release; pumps keep the last library if the server is down
treatment_plan: Patch the server with manufacturer approval; move to the device network; alert on library changes; restrict server access to the pharmacist and biomed

threat_event: Malware on the flat network disrupts building automation, including negative-pressure room and pharmacy temperature control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Building OT on the user network; vendor default settings unknown
existing_controls: Controllers keep running locally if the network fails; manual temperature logs
treatment_plan: Move OT to its own network segment; inventory OT devices and vendor remote access

threat_event: A former agency nurse or contracted clinician signs in to the EHR after the assignment ends
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agencies do not report end dates; 11 stale accounts found in July 2026
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(3)(ii)(C)); C-HPH-R08 (CPG: Revoke Credentials for Departing Workforce Members)
existing_controls: Employee terminations handled by HR ticket
treatment_plan: End dates required on every contracted and agency account; automatic expiry; monthly reconciliation with each agency and the medical staff office

threat_event: A workforce member views records of neighbors or well-known local patients without a job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small community; EHR access reports reviewed only after a complaint
existing_controls: Role-based access; sanctions in the employee handbook
treatment_plan: Monthly EHR access report review with focus on staff and well-known patients; HIPAA sanctions procedure

threat_event: Actions under shared generic accounts cannot be traced to a person during an investigation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared accounts on the ED tracking board, analyzer middleware workstation, and nursing station
existing_controls: Physical location limits who can use each shared account
treatment_plan: Replace with named accounts or badge-tap sign-in; view-only kiosk mode for the tracking board

threat_event: Business email compromise of a staff mailbox exposes PHI sent to transfer partners
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PHI routinely emailed; no mailbox auditing review
existing_controls: MFA on email
treatment_plan: Training; enforced encryption for external PHI email; mailbox sign-in alerts

threat_event: Theft of an unencrypted workstation on wheels exposes cached PHI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 88 desktops and workstations on wheels are unencrypted; ED is open 24x7
existing_controls: ED entrance badge-controlled at night; cameras
treatment_plan: Full-disk encryption on all desktops and workstations on wheels

threat_event: A fiber cut isolates the hospital from the hosted EHR and cloud workloads for more than a shift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One fiber circuit; cellular backup carries limited traffic; no tested failover
existing_controls: Cellular backup on the firewall
treatment_plan: Second diverse carrier; quarterly failover test; prioritize EHR and phone traffic on the backup link

threat_event: A hurricane forces shelter-in-place for several days with commercial power and connectivity lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single campus; one internet circuit; plan tested for power but not for IT systems
existing_controls: Emergency preparedness plan; generator with on-site fuel; annual community exercise
treatment_plan: Add IT dependencies and satellite communications to the hurricane annex; test downtime PCs on generator power

threat_event: During a cyberattack, staff do not know who decides diversion or how to run paper operations, and a CMS survey later cites the emergency program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Emergency preparedness risk assessment and plan omit cyberattacks and prolonged EHR outages; no cyber exercise
existing_controls: Hurricane-focused plan reviewed in 2025
treatment_plan: Add cyberattack and EHR outage to the all-hazards risk assessment; add diversion criteria; use a ransomware tabletop as the 2026-27 second exercise

threat_event: A teleradiology or telepharmacy outage or breach stops image reads or after-hours order verification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single provider for each; no security review; no tested backup arrangement
existing_controls: BAAs in place
treatment_plan: Annual vendor security review; written backup arrangements (on-call radiologist by phone; consultant pharmacist callback)

threat_event: Compromise of the MSP's remote management tool gives attackers administrator access to every server and workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP tool has unrestricted access; no MSP security review; MSP accounts are standing administrators
existing_controls: BAA with the MSP; EDR
treatment_plan: MFA and source restrictions on the MSP tool; separate MSP admin accounts per technician; annual MSP security review with its SOC 2 report

threat_event: PHI disclosed by the cloud fax service or the biomedical service contractor without a BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No BAA; no vendor security review
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Execute BAAs or replace vendors; no ePHI until signed

threat_event: The sepsis prediction model misses early sepsis or floods nurses with false alerts, and treatment is delayed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No local validation before go-live; no monitoring of alert rates or outcomes
regulatory_driver: N62-R07 (45 CFR 92.210, parent vertical ID); ONC HTI-1 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11) (developer duty)
existing_controls: Sepsis screening protocol and physician judgment remain the standard of care
treatment_plan: Local validation, alert-rate monitoring, and go or no-go decision under P10

threat_event: The sepsis model performs worse for some patient groups, leading to unequal care (Section 1557 exposure)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Input variables not reviewed; no subgroup performance data from the vendor or local testing
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Input-variable review under 92.210(b); subgroup testing plan in P10; mitigation record under 92.210(c)

threat_event: Unpatched firewall or VPN firmware exploited for remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware updated only when the MSP notices; no vulnerability scanning
existing_controls: Management interface not exposed to the internet
treatment_plan: Monthly firmware review; external and internal vulnerability scanning with remediation deadlines

threat_event: Staff or contracted clinicians do not report a suspected incident, so breach clocks start unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident reporting channel; contracted clinicians outside training
existing_controls: IT help desk phone
treatment_plan: Publish a 24x7 reporting line; add to training and medical staff orientation

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through MFA fatigue or credential theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Hardware security keys for both administrators
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CEO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Clearinghouse outage delays claims and cash flow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single clearinghouse
existing_controls: Payer portals for urgent claims; Medicare periodic interim payments
treatment_plan: Accepted: 60 days of cash on hand covers a long outage

threat_event: Attacker uses the manufacturer default password on the patient monitor central station to silence or change alarm settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator password found on the central station (P07 testing)
existing_controls: Central station on the internal network only
treatment_plan: Change the password with the manufacturer's field engineer; add to the device network (R-006)

threat_event: A device returned to the biomedical service contractor leaves with stored ePHI and is not wiped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No BAA or sanitization clause with the biomedical contractor
existing_controls: Devices are logged when they leave for repair
treatment_plan: BAA with a sanitization clause; wipe or remove storage before devices leave

threat_event: Interface engine failure stops electronic laboratory reporting to the state health department and reportable results are late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single interface VM; no queue monitoring
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 interface engine; SYS-12; P05 BP-08
existing_controls: Laboratory staff phone urgent reportable results to the health department
treatment_plan: Interface queue monitoring and alerting

threat_event: OCR or CMS finds no current risk analysis after a breach, or the Promoting Interoperability attestation cannot be supported
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Risk analysis last updated in 2023; retention of security documents undefined
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A); 164.316(b)(2)(i)); 42 CFR 495.24 (security risk analysis attestation); C-HPH-R10 (recognized security practices)
existing_controls: 2026 risk analysis completed (this register)
treatment_plan: Annual risk analysis each July; six-year retention of security documentation

threat_event: Imaging archive restore fails and prior studies are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive never restore-tested; snapshots only in the same account
existing_controls: Daily snapshots; teleradiology group keeps its own copy of reads
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test of a sample of studies (same work as R-003)

threat_event: Denial of service against the patient portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted; outside hospital control
existing_controls: Vendor DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low

threat_event: Staff paste PHI into a public generative AI chatbot
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list for generative AI
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved-tools rule in POL-05; block unapproved AI sites on the web filter

threat_event: The VoIP phone system goes down with the network during an incident, so staff cannot coordinate diversion and transfers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phones depend on the flat network; analog backup lines only in the ED and at the nursing station
existing_controls: Two analog lines; EMS radio in the ED
treatment_plan: Put phones on their own segment; add analog or cellular phones at the nursing station, lab, and imaging; list them in the communication plan
